Container.Name: restic-ui
Container.Overview: Web UI for configuring and running restic backups. Manage repositories (local, S3-compatible, SFTP, rclone), schedule backup plans with retention, browse and restore files from any snapshot without FUSE, replicate snapshots to a second repository, and get notifications via Apprise.
Container.Description: Web UI + backend for restic backups, built for homelab use. Mount the shares you want to back up (read-only recommended) under /sources, and any local backup destination under /repos.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: App configuration, database, and generated master key

Config.Name: Sources (read-only)
Config.Description: Data to back up. Mount your shares here read-only.

Config.Name: Local repositories
Config.Description: Destination for local restic repositories (optional if only using cloud backends)

Config.Name: Master key
Config.Description: Key used to encrypt stored credentials. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32. If empty, one is generated and stored in /config/secret.key (back it up!).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file ownership (Unraid default: 99 / nobody)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file ownership (Unraid default: 100 / users)
